--frequently-asked-questions
What is AQMath?
A non-custodial tool for long-term passive crypto portfolio management using DCA and quantitative optimization (Risk Parity).
How does DCA distribution work?
You enter a total budget, and the app allocates it to tokens below their target allocation, considering risk and average cost.
What does the AQMath Engine do?
It uses 180 days of price history to compute optimal allocation weights (Risk Parity) so each token contributes equally to portfolio risk.
How to import data?
You can manually enter, import a CSV with transactions (Date, Type, Symbol, Amount) or load a previously exported JSON.
What do ❄️ / 🔥 mean?
Freeze (❄️) excludes the token from DCA and optimization; useful for positions you don’t want to change.
Why the ⚠️ warning?
The token has less than 180 days of price history – optimization results are less reliable.
What is Safe-Haven (USDC)?
When enabled, USDC acts as a stablecoin buffer. Excess funds from hard caps and unallocated DCA budget flow into USDC instead of being lost. Toggle it OFF to treat USDC as a normal token.
Is my data safe?
Your portfolio amounts, targets, and allocation choices are stored in your browser (localStorage). During DCA and Optimize, positions are sent to our backend, processed in-memory, and discarded immediately. The only server-side records are the one-way hashed beta-key activation (with a hashed IP fingerprint) and — only if you opt in to the signal & notification service — your holdings under your hashed key, deleted on withdrawal. Non-custodial by design.
